layers.text: Erase everything that stands on the dark round slab: the cream cup, the red thing and the small pale lumps are all removed. The slab's top becomes one smooth empty glossy surface of very dark navy ice, colour #1c233e, with one bold white shine streak across it and two short thin pale blue cracks. Do not redraw anything else: keep the round slab's shape, its rim of sharp bright blue ice spikes, the thick black outline and the art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
